title: Credit Card (Qantas edition) Pro-rata refund of annual fee list
body:
Hi all,
I went on a bit of a CC (Qantas) craze and racked up a nice sum of Qantas points.
Just want to share with you all the CC that allows Pro-rata refunds of the annual fee:
Qantas Premier Platinum - Pro-rata refund via telephone . You will need to call them up and ask for it. My account is about 1 and a half months old post-annual fee. I am getting about $190 back from $225. They will send the refund via cheque .
Westpac Altitude (Qantas) - Pro-rata refund via telephone & Live chat . You will need to ask for it. My account is about 2 months old post-annual fee and I was able to get the full annual fee back ($49). They will transfer it to a nominated bank account within 3 bd.
NAB Qantas Premium Card - Pro-rata refund via telephone & Live Chat . You will need to ask for it. My account is about 2 months old post-annual fee and I was able to get the full annual fee back ($250). They will transfer it to a nominated bank account within 10 bd.
Other users experience
@Autonomic - ANZ - telephone - Full refund after 2 months post-annual fee payment.
